convert_eomt_model_to_hf: convert an EOMT model checkpoint to HuggingFace format and save locally
convert_eomt_model_to_hub: convert an EOMT model checkpoint to HuggingFace format and push to the hub
load_eomt_state_dict: load a sharded or single-file EOMT model state dict from a local directory
ensure_model_downloaded: ensure an EOMT model is downloaded locally from HuggingFace Hub
convert_state_dict_keys: convert old EOMT checkpoint keys to new HuggingFace format using regex mappings
